concerns.location: tasks.md:Line 78 (T009) – “Implement a dataset‑download script … – satisfies FR‑001”
concerns.text: The task claims FR‑001 (and FR‑015) is satisfied, but the repository currently lacks the required file `src/data/download_gsm8k.py` and the checksum manifest `data/checksums.txt`. This constitutes a semantic weakening of the functional requirement.

FR‑007 mandates logging of peak CPU RAM usage and total wall‑clock time via `src/utils/logging.py`. The listed task only creates a generic JSON‑line logger and does not implement the required resource‑monitoring functions, leaving FR‑007 unfulfilled.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Line 31 (T004) – “Add a GitHub Actions CI workflow … (file: .github/workflows/ci.yml)” (completed) and Line 33 (T004b) – “Implement GitHub Actions CI workflow (file: .github/workflows/ci.yml)” (pending)
concerns.text: FR‑012 requires a fully functional CI workflow that enforces RAM and time limits. The workflow file is marked as completed, yet the implementation task (T004b) remains undone, meaning the CI script is likely empty or incomplete, violating the requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Line 27 (T005) – “Create a top‑level README.md … (file: README.md)” (completed) and Line 29 (T005b) – “Implement top‑level README.md (file: README.md)” (pending)
concerns.text: FR‑013 demands a README with quick‑start and usage instructions. Only a placeholder README has been created; the substantive content required by the specification is missing, weakening the reproducibility guarantee.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Lines 88‑92 (T008b, T042, T043) – contradictory handling of resource limits (warnings vs. errors)
concerns.text: The resource‑monitoring module logs warnings when limits are exceeded (T008b) while separate tasks (T042, T043) raise errors on the same limits. This inconsistency dilutes the enforcement of Constitution VII (Extreme Resource Constraints Verification) and may allow runs that should be rejected to pass.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Line 210 (T021) – “Implement statistical analysis module … (FR‑009, FR‑006, FR‑011)” but no explicit task ties this to FR‑021 (power analysis for US‑2)
concerns.text: FR‑021 requires a dedicated power‑analysis for the paired t‑tests in US‑2. Although T021 performs power analysis, it is not explicitly linked to FR‑021, risking an orphaned requirement.
